intro.h2: Remodeling that moves as fast as you do
paragraphs: GMG Home Solutions handles bathroom remodeling in Raleigh-Durham, NC, along with countertops and backsplashes. What sets us apart is speed without shortcuts. One client heard back within an hour, had an estimate visit the next morning, got a quote an hour after that and had the work installed the following day.

Another homeowner went from first conversation to finished countertop replacement in about a week. Bigger jobs get the same care. A longtime client came back years after his granite install to renovate his master bath, kept his Brazilian granite for a new vanity, and says the cost was very reasonable for the craftsmanship and advice.

items.name: Master bathroom renovations
items.blurb: Full bathroom renovations with new tile, plumbing fixtures and vanities. Guillermo guides you through tile and fixture choices. One recent master bath got green herringbone tile, a pebble shower floor, lighted mirrors and the owner's own Brazilian granite, reused on a new vanity of a different size.

image.alt: Master bathroom with green herringbone wall tile, a dark wood double vanity with granite top and lighted mirrors

items.name: Tile showers
items.blurb: Walk-in showers built around the tile you choose. One recent shower has green herringbone walls, two lighted niches, a pebble floor and a frameless glass door. Another bathroom pairs a glass shower and bench in marble-look tile with a freestanding tub.

image.alt: Walk-in shower with green herringbone tile, two lighted niches, pebble floor and frameless glass door

items.name: Granite countertops and replacements
items.blurb: We install custom granite countertops in kitchens and bathrooms, including Brazilian granite for one longtime client. One countertop replacement went from a same-day site visit and quote to prep the next day, and the whole job was done in roughly a week.

image.alt: L-shaped white kitchen countertop with a built-in cooktop and undermount sink

items.name: Kitchen backsplash
items.blurb: A new backsplash can change a kitchen in a day. Luis and two crew members handle the prep, cutting and cleanup. One client found us on Thumbtack, got a very reasonable quote within an hour of the visit and had the backsplash installed the next day.

image.alt: Kitchen with a white herringbone tile backsplash, wood cabinets and a white island top

items.title: Quick answers, quick starts
items.text: Reviewers describe replies within an hour, site visits the same day or the next morning, and installs as soon as the following day. One says she had never seen such a timely response.

items.title: Father and son on the job
items.text: Owner Guillermo often answers the first call himself, and his son Guillermo and installer Luis's crew work with him on the job. Reviewers name all three.

items.title: Clients come back
items.text: One homeowner had us install Brazilian granite in his kitchen and master bath years ago, then came back to have us renovate the whole master bath.

items.title: Reasonable, on schedule
items.text: Clients call our prices very reasonable for the craftsmanship and advice. One says the work was done on schedule and that any issues were addressed immediately.

about.text: GMG Home Solutions LLC is a bathroom remodeler led by owner Guillermo. He works with his son, also named Guillermo, who sent one client her quote within an hour of the visit, and with installer Luis and his crew. Some clients first hired GMG for custom granite countertops and came back years later for a full bathroom renovation. Today the team takes on bathrooms, tile showers, countertop replacements and backsplashes. Reviews keep coming back to the same things: fast replies, sound advice on tile and fixtures, careful prep and cleanup, and a work ethic that makes clients want to hire GMG again.

items.name: Kenneth G.
items.text: I first worked with Guillermo ,owner of GMG Home Solutions LLC, years ago when they installed beautiful Brazilian granite custom counter tops in my kitchen and master bath. I was happy enough to reach out again when I wanted to totally renovate my master bath, but wanted to still use the same granite on a different sized Vanity. Guillermo helped guide us through excellent choices of gorgeous tile and beautiful plumbing fixtures. All of the work was done very efficiently with great detail and care. The cost considering all the services, craftsmanship and sound advice was very reasonable and done on schedule. Any issues were immediately addressed and I couldn’t be happier. I highly recommend this company to help with your remodeling projects.

items.name: Irene M.
items.text: Had GMG Home Solutions install a kitchen backsplash for me.They were absolutely wonderful to work with. I went on thumbtack and the owner Guillermo responded within an hour and we set up an appointment to come by the next morning for an estimate. Within an hour of his visit I had a response from his son Guillermo with a very reasonable quote and that they could install the next day. Luis the installer,  and his two other crew members, assisted with prepping, cutting, and cleanup. What an efficient group! I will use them again in a heartbeat. In recent years I have never a such a timely response and such great work ethic and workmanship. Give them a call you won’t be sorry!

items.name: John D.
items.text: Guillermo and his team were fantastic to work with from start to finish. He was extremely prompt to talk out the overall job scope. Came out on site same day to gather info and quote and was back the next day to prep for the counter replacement. Full job was completed in roughly 1 week from initial conversation. Highly recommend for your countertop upgrade needs and any other projects they can take on.

service_area.text: GMG Home Solutions is a service-area business, so we come to you for bathroom renovations, countertops and backsplashes. Our phone number, (919) 813-9223, is a Raleigh-Durham area line. Call Monday to Friday from 9 AM to 6 PM or Saturday from 9 AM to 3 PM, tell us your town, and we will tell you whether we can schedule a visit.

items.a: Often very quickly. One client had an estimate visit the morning after she reached out and her backsplash installed the day after the quote. Another had a same-day site visit, prep the next day and the countertop job done in about a week.

Yes. Quotes are free. Call (919) 813-9223 or email info@gmghomesolutionsllc.com, and we will set up a time to see the space. One client had a very reasonable quote within an hour of the visit, and another had a same-day visit and quote.

items.q: Can I reuse my existing granite in a new bathroom?
items.a: In some cases, yes. A longtime client wanted to keep his Brazilian granite while renovating his master bath with a different-sized vanity. Guillermo worked it into the new design along with new tile and plumbing fixtures. Ask us about your stone during the visit.

We are open Monday through Friday from 9 AM to 6 PM and Saturday from 9 AM to 3 PM. We are closed on Sunday. Call (919) 813-9223 during those hours, or email info@gmghomesolutionsllc.com with a short description of your project and a few photos.

items.q: Who will be working in my home?
items.a: Owner Guillermo, his son Guillermo, and installer Luis with his crew. Clients describe them as efficient and careful, with a great work ethic. On one backsplash job, Luis and two crew members handled the prepping, cutting and cleanup. If anything needs attention afterward, Guillermo deals with it right away.

final_cta.text: Call Guillermo and his team for a free quote on your project.
